extracted.summary: Extended WhatsApp conversation between Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about buying a home; Layla laid out budget, family, and property requirements over several weeks, a viewing was confirmed, and both sides made specific commitments while lease deadlines and bonus timing were also discussed. Ongoing WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad over several months about a property search; Layla and her husband Karim share location and floor preferences, Sam sends listings and commits to send a snagging checklist, and several family and timing details come up along the way. Months-long WhatsApp conversation between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad about her property search, with listings shared, a stated budget around 3.5–3.8m, a requirement for a gym in the building, and a target closing date before 1 September 2026; several promises were made along the way (a bank valuation report, a landlord confirmation, and a mortgage broker introduction). Ongoing property search for Layla Haddad that evolved from a 3-bedroom to a 4-bedroom need after her mother-in-law decided to move in, with an added interest in a small investment studio; the rep committed to several follow-up actions after a recent viewing. Extended WhatsApp exchange with Layla Haddad about a property viewing process; Sam made several follow-up commitments after a viewing, a meeting was confirmed for 12 November 2026, and Layla shared Karim's birthday and their wedding anniversary dates.
